integrity: The result is proved symbolically. Infinite support is handled by operator-norm convergence in the \(\ell_1\) convolution algebra, and boundary spectral points are handled by explicit adjoint eigenfunctionals rather than numerical approximation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to scalar one-sided convolution on complex \(\ell_\infty(\mathbb N_0)\) with kernel in \(\ell_1(\mathbb N_0)\).
No assertion is made for two-sided Laurent convolution, matrix-valued kernels, or kernels outside \(\ell_1\).
The boundary residual-spectrum argument uses shift-invariant Banach limits.
title: Purely residual fine spectrum for one-sided \(\ell_1\) convolution on \(\ell_\infty\)
